name: BigQuery
sku: BigQuery. BigQuery ML and Dataform are not scored here; Dataform has its own record.

store.warehouse.note: A fully managed data platform with a storage layer and a separate compute layer that scale independently, and a serverless architecture with no infrastructure to manage.

serve.query-engine.note: ANSI-standard SQL queries, plus Python through BigQuery DataFrames, on the serverless compute layer.

transform.code-transform.note: BigQuery DataFrames lets Python users analyse and transform data in BigQuery. SQL transformation workflows are scored under Dataform.

store.table-format.note: Supports open table formats Apache Iceberg, Delta and Hudi through BigLake tables and managed Iceberg tables.

ingest.batch-extract.note: Loads batch files in Avro, Parquet, CSV and JSON. It loads what is handed to it; it does not pull from source systems, which Datastream and others do.

ingest.stream-ingest.note: The Storage Write API streams rows in continuously.

bands.note: Dynamic data masking obscures a column for chosen users while still letting them query it, with rules such as nullify, SHA-256 hash, default value, email mask and random hash, attached through policy tags.
Column-level security through policy tags in inheriting taxonomies, with a Fine-Grained Reader role for unmasked access.

presentation.tagline: Serverless data warehouse with SQL, Python, open table formats and column masking.
